Find suspicious code in a student file

Source: R/integrity.R
scan_code.Rd

Looks for calls that change how other code behaves (attach(), unlockBinding(), registerS3method(), trace(), setMethod() and similar), writes into the global or base environment, code built from strings with parse(text = ), and replacement of a function's body or environment. grade_exercise() runs it on every submission and puts the findings in the message column as "suspicious code: ...". The code is only read, never run.

Usage

scan_code(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an R file.

Value

Character vector of findings such as "attach() at line 3"; empty when nothing is found or the file does not parse.

Examples

file <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
writeLines(c("f <- function(x) x", 'attach(list(isTRUE = function(x) TRUE))'), file)
scan_code(file)
#> [1] "attach() at line 2"
